details.description: Voxtral TTS is Mistral AI's text-to-speech model, released March 23, 2026, aimed at voice-agent and other real-time speech applications. It generates expressive speech and clones a voice from a reference sample as short as 2-3 seconds, without needing a transcript of that voice prompt, and Mistral says it captures the source voice's accent, inflections, intonation and disfluencies. It is a lightweight 4-billion-parameter system combining a 3.4B-parameter transformer decoder, a 390M-parameter flow-matching acoustic transformer, and a 300M-parameter neural audio codec; a version with several reference voices is released as open weights on Hugging Face under a CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial) license.
advantages: Clones a voice from a reference sample as short as 2-3 seconds, with no transcript of the voice prompt required (Mistral AI, "Speaking of Voxtral").
Supports zero-shot cross-lingual voice adaptation: generating speech in one language from a voice sample recorded in another while preserving the speaker's accent (Mistral AI, "Speaking of Voxtral").
Mistral reports a model latency of 70ms for a typical 10-second, 500-character input, with a real-time factor of about 9.7x (Mistral AI, "Speaking of Voxtral").

In Mistral's own human evaluation, the model was rated more natural than ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 at similar time-to-first-audio, and reached quality parity with ElevenLabs v3 in a zero-shot multilingual custom-voice setting (Mistral AI, "Speaking of Voxtral").
disadvantages: Documented for 9 languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Dutch, Portuguese, Italian, Hindi, Arabic), narrower than some competing TTS models (Mistral AI, "Speaking of Voxtral").
The naturalness and quality comparisons against ElevenLabs are Mistral's own human evaluation, not an independent third-party benchmark (Mistral AI, "Speaking of Voxtral").
The open-weights release is under a CC BY-NC 4.0 license, which restricts commercial use of the downloaded weights (Mistral AI, "Speaking of Voxtral").
use_cases: Low-latency speech synthesis for voice agents and conversational AI
Branded or custom voice generation via short-sample voice cloning
Real-time speech translation using cross-lingual voice adaptation that preserves speaker identity
Customer support, financial services, and other real-time spoken-response applications (Mistral AI, "Speaking of Voxtral")

sources.title: Text to Speech - Mistral AI Documentation

notes: Model doc page (docs.mistral.ai/models/voxtral-tts-26-03) lists both 'voxtral-mini-tts-2603' and 'voxtral-mini-tts-latest' together as the model's id/alias pair, confirming 'latest' currently resolves to this dated 2603 release. Mistral's human-evaluation comparisons against ElevenLabs are described only qualitatively ('widens the quality gap', 'parity with the quality of'), with no numeric 0-100 accuracy score given, so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. The '2-3 second' voice-cloning sample length is not on either originally-cited page (the launch blog gives 'a voice prompt (5 to 25 seconds)' for the standard input and 'a reference as little as 3s' for the adaptation training); the current capabilities/audio/text_to_speech doc page states 'Clone any voice from as little as 2-3 seconds of audio', so that page was added as the source for the claim instead of removing it. Catalog facts give no max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens for this model and none were found on the maker's pages either.
